P2. THE FENCE PARSER TAKES THE FIRST SESSION FIELD IT FINDS IN A BLOCK. Its

    TITLE contains that word, as one written this session did, makes the parser
    capture the following character instead of the identifier, and the hook
    then refuses the very session that owns the fence. Candidate fix: anchor
    the field to the start of a line, or require it on the line after the
    title. Cheap workaround meanwhile: never write that word in a fence title.
